name: code-review
description: Review code for quality, bugs, and best practices

inputs.name: filePath
inputs.description: Path to code file to review

executionSteps: Understand the code's purpose and context
Check for potential bugs and edge cases
Check official documentation for best practices (if enabled)

expectedOutputs.name: review_report
expectedOutputs.description: Structured code review with findings categorized by severity

expectedOutputs.name: recommendations
expectedOutputs.description: List of actionable recommendations for improvement

expectedOutputs.name: code_excerpts
expectedOutputs.description: Relevant code excerpts showing issues or exemplary patterns

successCriteria: Issues identified with clear severity levels (critical, major, minor)
Actionable recommendations provided for each issue
Code excerpts included to illustrate findings
